# Hike Doggie

> Professional dog hiking and walking service with multi-city franchise locations across the United States.

Hike Doggie operates a network of regional dog care services specializing in outdoor hiking adventures and professional dog walking. The company has expanded to multiple metropolitan areas including Denver, Nashville, Albuquerque, and Atlanta, offering both direct services and franchise opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Dog hiking service
- Professional dog walking
- Pet sitting and care
- Dog health and exercise
- Multi-city expansion
- Franchise opportunities
- Location-based services
- Denver Metro
- Flatirons
- Treasure Valley
- Music City
- Sandia region
- North Atlanta
- Outdoor pet care
